title: Animate Present and Plugin Crates
description: Create animate/present/rs (animate_present) and animate/plugin/rs (animate-plugin) crates by adapting framework/product/presentation domain and plugin.
summary: Created animate/present/rs (animate_present) with PresentDeck domain adapted from framework/product/presentation, scene document types (PresentScene/Section/Slide), compile_present_site static-site compiler, and nx tooling. Created animate/plugin/rs (animate-plugin) adapted from presentation plugin with animate-present-play app id, animate.present.deck schema, semio:animate component metadata, and animate playground ports. Registered both crates in root Cargo.toml. All 25 unit tests pass.
